summary:
Iteration 25 - frontend-only check of the mobile 'can't see loading animation' fix, plus a Send/Swap regression, on the preview. ALL PASS after one environment fix: the CRA dev server was still serving an OLD index.html (no #nc-boot, empty #root, no #f4f5ef body) even though frontend/public/index.html had changed 2 min earlier. The webpack dev server does not reload public/index.html, so I ran `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. After that, curl / shows <div id="root"><div id="nc-boot" data-testid="nc-boot"...> and html,body{background:#f4f5ef}.

SPLASH (/api/bifrost/v1/app/):
- Mobile 430x900: #nc-splash was attached at 0.42s. Parent is BODY, position fixed, z 2147483000, 430x900 full-screen. Text: 'SOLANA MAINNET / Getting ready / Syncing the pool'. At 1.74s the canvas was 344x150 with 4916 colored pixels; the screenshot shows the purple->blue->green dot-matrix 'SOL'. .sp-bar i animationName = 'ncBar', and its transform moves over time (-2.7 -> 353px). The message rotated to 'Loading your notes'. Splash removed at 2.71s (about 2.3s on screen, at least MIN_MS 1900). No splash after switching tabs.
- Desktop 1920x800: splash at 0.35s, canvas 8886 colored pixels, ncBar, full 1920x800 overlay, removed at 2.67s.
- /app redirect: lands on the mirror, splash at 0.51s, canvas 8898 colored pixels, removed at 2.81s. No long white screen.
- After the fade, the Welcome tour 'Skip intro' can be clicked on mobile and desktop (splash does not block clicks).

LANDING /: with CDP throttling (latency 400ms, 50KB/s), #nc-boot was visible at 1.22s. Body bg rgb(244,245,239); 42 animated dots; full-height overlay with a moving gradient bar. #nc-boot detached at 11.3s once React mounted, and the landing page then rendered normally.

REGRESSION (mobile, fresh vault TestPass!2026xyz each run):
- Swap SOL->Bonk amount 1: live quote 34,016,750.04 Bonk (~$105) within 1s; CTA 'Not enough private SOL'. Amount 4: 136,109,277 Bonk. Never stuck on 'quoting'.
- Send SOL amount 4 to 5tzF...uAi9: the CTA showed only 'Not enough private SOL' for 15s and never 'Working out the fee…'. Relayer fee 0 SOL.
- No pageerror in any run.

issues: The 'You pay' / Amount token starts as 'Select' (no token) and Swap receive defaults to SOL. The user must pick SOL first. Minor: consider defaulting pay to SOL.

action_items: Remember that changes to frontend/public/index.html need `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` in preview, because the CRA dev server keeps serving the old HTML. I already restarted it this run. Production nullcash.fun needs a redeploy to get #nc-boot and the splash.
(Optional) Default the Swap/Send pay token to SOL instead of 'Select'.
critical_code_review_comments: ensureSplash(): sizing from offsetWidth fixes the empty canvas (thousands of colored px now). Appending to body with MIN_MS 1900 and a 20s hard fallback works. The fallback guarantees removal even if main.main never appears.
The resize listener in ensureSplash is never removed after the splash is gone. It is guarded by box.isConnected, so it is harmless but leaks one listener per page load.
The #nc-boot inline loader is removed both by React replacing #root and by ensureSplash (boot.remove()). Fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors: splash #nc-splash / canvas / .sp-bar i. Landing boot loader [data-testid=nc-boot]. Dock Send = #nc-dock-send. Do NOT use 'text=Pay' because it matches the 'YOU PAY' label on Swap. Token pills are main button.tok; picker rows are .sheet .tok-list button.wopt with search .sheet input.inp. The first main .btn-primary can be a hidden 'Add to Chrome' button, so filter by offsetParent.
rca of the issue: Confirmed fixed on preview. Additional finding: the preview dev server had not picked up the new index.html until the frontend was restarted.
